answer.short_answer:
The FDA labels indicate that metformin hydrochloride tablets are approved for use in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus, to improve glycemic control as an adjunct to diet and exercise [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-2].

In contrast, metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets are approved for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-3]. A combination product, ZITUVIMET, which includes sitagliptin and metformin hydrochloride, is also approved for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-1].

These labels establish the intended uses and populations for each formulation, but do not provide information on the size of the benefit for type 2 diabetes mellitus [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-2] [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-1] [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-3].
